actions.customApiCall.description: Send a SigV4-signed request to the Lambda API in the connection's region. Method, path, query, headers, and JSON body are yours.
actions.customApiCall.props.body.descrip: Optional JSON body for POST, PUT, and PATCH.
actions.customApiCall.props.headers.desc: Optional headers. Host and Authorization are set for you.
Optional query string. Keys with empty values are skipped.
actions.customApiCall.props.timeout.desc: How long to wait. Defaults to 30 seconds. Maximum is 900.
actions.getFunctionDetails.description: Return a function's ARN, runtime, handler, memory, timeout, and state.
actions.getFunctionDetails.props.functio: Name, partial ARN, or full ARN of the function.
actions.getFunctionDetails.props.include: Values may contain secrets and will appear in run logs.
actions.getFunctionDetails.props.qualifi: Optional version or alias. Leave empty to read $LATEST.
actions.invokeFunction.description: Invoke a Lambda function synchronously or asynchronously and return the status code, function error, and payload.
actions.invokeFunction.props.failOnFunct: Fail this step when the function throws, instead of returning the error.
actions.invokeFunction.props.functionNam: Name or ARN. Append :alias to target an alias.
actions.invokeFunction.props.invocationT: Synchronous waits for the result. Asynchronous returns once queued.
actions.invokeFunction.props.payload.des: JSON sent to the function. Leave empty to send no payload.
actions.invokeFunction.props.qualifier.d: Optional version or alias. Leave empty to invoke $LATEST.
description: Invoke functions and watch for new ones
triggers.newFunctionCreated.description: Fires when a Lambda function ARN appears that was not present the last time this trigger ran. Enabling it records the current functions and stays quiet.
